content: 1. Efavirenz increases the levels or effects of intravenous ibuprofen by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Close monitoring is recommended when these drugs are co-administered. 2. Efavirenz and ibutilide both prolong the QTc interval, which can lead to serious cardiac risks. It is advised to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 3. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of idelalisib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, or an alternative drug should be used. 4. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce systemic exposure to idelalisib. Idelalisib also increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 5. Idelalisib is a strong CYP3A inhibitor, and co-administration with sensitive CYP3A substrates should be avoided. Close monitoring is required. 6. Efavirenz increases the toxicity of ifosfamide by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. CYP3A4 inducers may increase the metabolism of ifosfamide to its active alkylating metabolites, as well as its neurotoxic and nephrotoxic metabolite, chloroacetaldehyde. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Efavirenz increases the effects of ifosfamide by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 metabolism. Co-administration with CYP2B6 inducers may increase the metabolism of ifosfamide to its metabolites. Monitor for increased effects or toxicities. 8. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of iloperidone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Iloperidone increases the levels of efavirenz by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Efavirenz and iloperidone both prolong the QTc interval, posing a serious risk. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 10. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of imatinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 11. Efavirenz increases the levels or effects of imipramine by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. Both efavirenz and imipramine prolong the QTc interval, which can lead to serious cardiac risks. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of imipramine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 13. Efavirenz and indacaterol (inhaled) both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Efavirenz and indinavir both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Close monitoring is recommended. 15. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of indinavir by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use an alternative drug if possible. 16. Indinavir increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 17. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of infigratinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 18. Efavirenz and inotuzumab both prolong the QTc interval, posing a serious risk. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 19. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of irinotecan by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 20. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of liposomal irinotecan by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 21. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 22. Efavirenz and isoflurane both prolong the QTc interval, posing a serious risk. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 23. Isoniazid increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of isosorbide dinitrate by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of isosorbide mononitrate by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of isradipine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both efavirenz and isradipine prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 27. Istradefylline increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of istradefylline by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 29. Efavirenz and itraconazole both prolong the QTc interval, posing a serious risk. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 32. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of ivabradine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 33. Ivacaftor increases the levels of efavirenz by inhibiting CYP3A4, while efavirenz decreases the levels of ivacaftor by inducing CYP enzymes. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 34. Ivosidenib decreases the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 35. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of ixabepilone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. It also decreases the levels or effects of ketamine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Ketoconazole increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of ketoconazole by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 40. Efavirenz and lamivudine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 41. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of lansoprazole by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It also increases the levels or effects of lansoprazole by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 42. Use caution and monitor closely. 43. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of larotrectinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 44. Efavirenz and lasmiditan both increase sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 58. This combination is contraindicated. 63. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 64. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of lopinavir by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 66. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of loratadine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both loratadine and efavirenz increase sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 67. Efavirenz decreases the levels or effects of lorlatinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 68. Efavirenz increases the levels or effects of losartan by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. It may also inhibit the conversion of losartan to its active metabolite E-3174. Use caution and monitor closely.
